description: Save content written in this chat as a file in a bucket, up to 5 MB. Nubbo passes it to the bucket and keeps nothing. For larger files use create_upload_link.

conflict.description: When the path exists: fail (default), rename the new file, or replace the old one

encoding.description: utf8 for text (default), base64 for binary content

path.description: Path of the new file, such as "notes/summary.md"

name: upload_file
title: Upload a small file
